{{Quote|I've tagged Fli'teri and Jinmin Tokati for the Kothlis inquiries. If either calls back, let them know I'll be in touch later tonight.|Bail Organa, to [[Minala Lodilyn]]|<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref>}}
'''Fli'teri''' was an individual who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Following a [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] tasked Fli'teri and [[Jinmin Tokati]] with undertaking enquiries in relation to the battle on his behalf.<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth" />
